title: An outlier lecture on personal accountability

cues.en: -: Hi, everyone.
cues.zh: 大家好。

cues.en: I hope you don't mind if I draw your attention away from the course material for just a moment.
cues.zh: 希望你不介意，我把你的注意力暫時從課程內容移開一下。

cues.en: I want to talk about an important challenge in online learning, and this is just to get you thinking about this issue.
cues.zh: 我想談談線上學習的一個重要挑戰，只是希望讓你思考這個問題。

cues.en: Now, it will come as no surprise that I am a huge fan of online education.
cues.zh: 我非常支持線上教育，這應該不讓人意外。

cues.en: It has so many advantages, like access to high quality education at low cost for people all over the world, the ability for you, the learner,
cues.zh: 它有很多優點，例如讓世界各地的人用低成本取得高品質教育，讓身為學習者的你，

cues.en: to custom tailor your education to best match what you want to learn, and of course, the ability to watch and repeat any lecture at any time
cues.zh: 依照最想學的內容量身打造教育，當然還可以按照自己的時間安排，隨時觀看、重看任何一堂課，

cues.en: according to your own schedule.
cues.zh: 配合自己的行程。

cues.en: But online education also has some drawbacks, some limitations, and some challenges.
cues.zh: 但線上教育也有一些缺點、限制和挑戰。

cues.en: And here, I want to talk about one of those, which is the minimal accountability with online learning.
cues.zh: 這裡想談其中一項，就是線上學習缺少督促與責任約束。

cues.en: You see, when you are in a traditional classroom setting with a teacher and other students, you have this entire external support structure
cues.zh: 在傳統教室，有老師和其他學生，你會有一整套外部支持結構，

cues.en: to keep you going, keep you motivated, and make sure that you are up-to-date and up to speed with your work.
cues.zh: 幫助你持續前進、保持動力，確保你的課業跟得上進度。

cues.en: Make sure that you keep studying consistently throughout the duration of the course.
cues.zh: 確保在整個課程期間持續穩定學習。

cues.en: And that's really difficult to maintain in online course settings because very often, there is no external accountability.
cues.zh: 在線上課程中，要維持這點很困難，因為往往沒有外部督促。

cues.en: Most of the time, it's just you.
cues.zh: 大部分時間只有你自己。

cues.en: So if you work hard or lazy, or you work fast or slow, it's pretty likely that no one's gonna notice other than you.
cues.zh: 所以，不管努力還是偷懶、進度快還是慢，很可能除了自己，沒有人會注意。

cues.en: So no one's gonna remind you when you start going a few days or even a few weeks without watching a lecture.
cues.zh: 當你幾天，甚至幾個星期沒有看課時，不會有人提醒。

cues.en: And you know as well as I do that as soon as it becomes easy to take one day off, then it's even easier to take two days off and then three days off, then a week off,
cues.zh: 你和我都知道，一旦很容易休息一天，就更容易休息兩天、三天，接著一週，

cues.en: and we all know where it goes from there.
cues.zh: 之後會怎麼發展，大家都知道。

cues.en: So what I would like you to do after watching this video is to take a moment to reflect on this issue of accountability.
cues.zh: 所以看完影片後，希望你花一點時間，反思這個自我負責與督促的問題。

cues.en: How important is it to you?
cues.zh: 它對你有多重要？

cues.en: Is it something that you think about, something you worry about, or maybe you just don't care about it?
cues.zh: 你會思考、會擔心這件事，還是根本不在意？

cues.en: Is it challenging for you, or is it easy for you to keep yourself motivated and keep working consistently?
cues.zh: 對你而言，維持動力和持續投入，是困難還是容易？

cues.en: Or are you not worried about consistent progress, and you're happy to work one period of time and then take a break and then work for another period of time and so on?
cues.zh: 或者你不在意持續進步，而是很樂意學一段時間、休息一下，再學一段時間，如此反覆？

cues.en: Maybe there are tricks that you use that you've developed or that you've learned from other people to help with this issue of accountability and self-motivation.
cues.zh: 也許你有自己開發，或從其他人學到的小技巧，能幫助自己負責、保持學習動力。

cues.en: So if you like, you can post a reply to the Q&A for this lecture, but it's totally not necessary.
cues.zh: 如果願意，可以在這堂課的問答區留言，但完全不是必要的。

cues.en: Mostly, I just want to bring up this important issue to make sure you are thinking about it because this is something I think about often.
cues.zh: 主要只是想提出這個重要問題，確保你有思考，因為這是我經常思考的事。

cues.en: I think this is one of the most important challenges of online education.
cues.zh: 我認為這是線上教育最重要的挑戰之一。
